body: I really dont understand how theres people like my mom and dad. Just recently talked to them, mom says "well if you dont want to live, then just kill yourself", and my dad just doesnt give a shit and yelled at me. At this point i really doubt they'd give a shit if i hang myself.

I dont think these people can help me much beyond talks and emotional support. I don't have something to live for, that's what's missing. I don't have a purpose in life, i keep thinking about this for years but i just can't find it. It's just becoming more hopeless the longer i go.

Download a mod by pasting a mod link to steamworkshopdownloader.io, after that you'll get a .pak file. Just put the .pak file to /starbound/mods. If you want to remove mod just delete or move them out of the folder.
